notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts.
description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking Smaug.
When Smaug enters, its first ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Smaug.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
